summary_bullets.claim: Addictiveness is the dominant strength — lean into this in marketing copy.

evidence.quote: Just wanted to have it always available even when I don't have the actual Bible with me. So much can be stored on my kindle that is very useful.

summary_bullets.claim: Ease of use and portability are key selling points.

evidence.quote: The quick Bible is awesome, I can access it from anywhere. The  best part I do not need the Internet to access it. Bravo!!!

summary_bullets.claim: Offline functionality is a major advantage.

evidence.quote: This app does not need an internet connection in order for you to use it so it is ideal for all of the places you may want to read your Bible but have no access to a wi-fi network.

This is a very nice Bible program. loads quickly, runs flawlessly, gives me the options i want (text size, colors, etc), along with bookmarks and the ability to add verse notes. exactly what i was looking for to use for my daily Bible reading.
I cannot carry my Bible with me everywhere I go, but, my Kindle Fire is always with me...love the convienience.....
This app does not need an internet connection in order for you to use it so it is ideal for all of the places you may want to read your Bible but have no access to a wi-fi network.
